title: Label the owner
prompt: OwnerLabel(string? owner) should return "Unassigned" when owner is null, and the owner's own text otherwise. An empty string is a real owner name here, so it is returned as it is. The starter gets both the missing case and the empty case wrong.
hints: What does owner.Length do when owner is null?
Only null means missing. An empty string must come back unchanged.
checkLabels: A named owner must be returned unchanged.
An empty owner name must be returned as it is.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Treats an empty string as a missing owner.
Replaces a missing owner with empty text instead of the label.

feedback: Check the three inputs separately: null, an empty string, and a name. Only null gets the label.
